definitions.planned_capacity: Sum of planned seats across all proposed sections, including blocked sections.
definitions.operational_capacity: Sum of section seats only where section_status is OPERATIONAL after all validations.
definitions.operationally_covered_demand: Per-course sum of min(forecast demand, operational capacity); this is coverage, not observed enrollment.
definitions.unmet_demand: Sum over courses of max(0, forecast demand - operational capacity); missing forecasts are excluded from known totals and counted explicitly.
definitions.missing_capacity: A course with no section capacity evidence is reported with zero proven operational capacity; missing forecast values remain unknown, not zero.
definitions.blocked_sections_by_rule: Unique section count for each rule code, excluding sections whose only blocker is UNSTAFFED. raw_violation_occurrences counts validation issue occurrences separately.
